purpose: Freeze failure semantics and invariants for the generic EBSD experimental-validation layer.
required_invariants: global sample rotation leaves internal child/child theory score invariant
wrong crystal-frame and active/passive hypotheses are not silently repaired
segmentation threshold is sensitivity-reported, not automatically declared physical truth
variant graph retains overlapping parent-domain candidates as ambiguity
plane-trace validation requires explicit specimen surface normal
quality fields are never converted to angular uncertainty without calibration
